reason: The hypothesis proposes applying ultrasonic burnishing, a severe plastic deformation technique, to a specific HEA bond coat (AlCoCrFeNi2.1) to reduce oxide spallation. None of the passages study ultrasonic burnishing on any HEA bond coat, nor do they propose it as future work. The mechanism linking UB-induced grain refinement and compressive stress to improved oxide adhesion and reduced spallation in this HEA system is not stated in any passage. The idea combines the known problem of spallation in this EHEA (P3, P5) with a surface treatment studied only on a different medium-entropy alloy (P32), transferring it to a new material and application with a reasoned mechanism.
